newsitem.title: USA: Minn. airport considering $94 mln parking garage.
newsitem.headline: Minn. airport considering $94 mln parking garage.

text.p: Metropolitan Airports Commission staff recommended Tuesday that commissioners build a new $94 million bond-financed parking garage at Minneapolis-St. Paul International Airport, a spokeswoman said.
Debt for the garage would be backed by parking revenues and negotiated charges for rental car companies that would be located in the new facility, spokeswoman Wendy Burt said.
The staff recommendation introduced to the commission's planning and environment committee Tuesday must return for consideration before the same group next month, Burt said.
The commission is also considering a rate increase on long-term airport parking to help pay the debt service.
The seven to nine level garage will add more than 5,000 public parking spaces and 3,000 rental car spaces to the 11,000 public parking spaces now available, Burt said.
Commission staff are also planning a people mover to connect the garage with the main terminal. The projects have been included in the commission's 1998 capital improvement budget.
The first parts of the garage could be completed in late 1998 or early 1999, Burt added.
